summary.short: Establishes criminal offences against computer systems, data, fraud and forgery in Chile, repeals Law 19.223, and amends criminal procedure and other laws to align with the Budapest Convention.
summary.long: Law 21.459 creates criminal offences against computer systems and data (Arts. 1-8), with prison terms and, for fraud, fines in monthly tax units. Article 2 exempts certain access to Chilean-domiciled systems that meets listed conditions, including Agency registration and prior reporting. Article 10 sets aggravating circumstances, including abuse of trust, of children, adolescents or older adults, and disruption of public utilities or elections. Title II lets investigations start on complaint of the Minister of Public Security (Art. 11) and lets judges order investigative techniques (Art. 12) and confiscation (Art. 13). Article 18 adds Criminal Procedure Code article 218 bis, letting prosecutors require service providers to preserve data for 90 days, extendable once up to 180, and keep the procedure secret. Article 17 repeals Law 19.223; Articles 19 to 21 amend three other laws. Article 18 takes effect after a Transport Ministry regulation; Articles 19 and 21 six months after publication.

relations.note: Article 17 repeals Ley 19.223 (the former computer crimes law), subject to the first transitional article. References to it are to be read as references to this law.

notes: Art. 9 and Art. 16 read only 'Derogado'; the Tribunal Constitucional certificate nevertheless refers to Art. 9 inciso tercero as reviewed and found conforming, which is inconsistent with the text. Standalone date lines '2024-09-04' and '2025-01-01' appear between articles and are not part of the operative text (apparently portal metadata); they are not coded as events. Art. 18 enters into force only six months after publication of a regulation by the Ministerio de Transportes y Telecomunicaciones (second transitional article); Arts. 19 and 21 enter into force six months after publication (third transitional article). The certificate lists Art. 12 among the articles sent for constitutional review, but the declaration does not mention it. The Agencia Nacional de Ciberseguridad is not defined in this text. Entity and relation target IDs are empty because no registry match was verified.

obligations.summary: A person who accesses a system without authorisation must, to be exempt from criminal liability, be registered in the register kept by the Agencia Nacional de Ciberseguridad and have informed the Agency in advance of the access.
obligations.conditional_on: Applies only to the exemption in Art. 2, inciso cuarto (access to a system whose owner is domiciled in Chile), and only if all listed conditions are met.

evidence.quote: Que se encuentre inscrito en el registro que al efecto lleve la Agencia Nacional de Ciberseguridad. Que el acceso se haya realizado habiendo informado previamente de ello a la Agencia.

obligations.summary: Report the access and any security vulnerabilities detected, as soon as the access is made, to the system owner and to the Agency; also comply with the Agency's rules on responsible vulnerability disclosure.
obligations.conditional_on: Applies only to the exemption in Art. 2, inciso cuarto, and only if all listed conditions are met.

evidence.quote: Que el acceso y las vulnerabilidades de seguridad detectadas hayan sido reportadas al responsable del sistema informático y a la Agencia, tan pronto se hubiere realizado.

obligations.summary: For the exemption, the access must not be made for appropriating or using information or with fraudulent intent, must not exceed what is needed to verify the vulnerability, must not use denial-of-service, malicious code, social engineering or data alteration or destruction, and must not publicly disclose the vulnerability.
obligations.conditional_on: Applies only to the exemption in Art. 2, inciso cuarto, and only if all listed conditions are met.

obligations.summary: For access to a system that is not of a State administration body, the access requires the consent of the person responsible for the system.
obligations.conditional_on: Applies only to the exemption in Art. 2, inciso cuarto, for systems other than those of organismos de la Administración del Estado.
